organic_growth.rate_effect_note: Strong organic growth in Steam Specialties and Watson-Marlow.
IP -4 to -5%; ETS organic -12%; Watson-Marlow strong.
'driven by volume growth and price increases to protect margins' (split not quantified); Steam Specialties +12%, ETS +14%; acquisitions Vulcanic, Durex, Cotopaxi.

Revenue GBP 1,702.9m. STS +1% organic (+3% ex large projects in China & Korea), ETS +11%, WMFTS +6%; IP 2.1%. Margins protected via 'pricing discipline' (not quantified). FX/acq split not extracted (reported-organic gap ~-3pts mainly FX, INFERENCE).

latest_interim.note: H1-26 revenue GBP 863.8m (+5% organic and reported; FX +1.1m, organic +40.5m): STS +1%, ETS +11%, WMFTS +7%. Trading update 11-Nov-2026: 10-month organic growth and margin ahead of H1; STS growth in Jul-Oct higher than H1; FY guidance mid-single-digit organic growth reaffirmed; net debt/EBITDA 1.3x at 31-Oct.

geography.largest_country: not disclosed in source (INFERENCE: United States)
geography.note: FY25 revenue by region (GBP m, total 1,702.9): Europe, Middle East & Africa 752.6 (44.2%; europe_pct includes ME&A), Americas 638.8 (37.5%; includes LatAm, so NA < 37.5%), Asia Pacific 311.5 (18.3%; 2024: 338.2). China: company states China ~15% of STS sales in 2025 -> ~GBP 128m = ~7.5% of group from STS alone; group China INFERENCE ~8-9%. Country-level split (AR note) not extracted.

claim_checks.claim: ETS recovery (margin to 18% by 2027 as thesis breaker)
claim_checks.finding: ETS organic: -12% (20), +7% (21), +14% (22), +2% (23), +10% (24), +11% (25), +11% (H1-26). ETS adjusted margin 9.2% FY25 (11.4% FY24) on the announcement's segment table basis, H1-26 margin improved to 17.2% (statutory/adjusted basis per CFO review; medium-term target 20%). Recovery in growth confirmed; margin progress from 2025 base is large - verify basis consistency before using 18% breaker. Semicon ~13% of ETS sales.

claim_checks.claim: China exposure ~10% of group (INFERENCE in qual)
claim_checks.finding: Company: China ~15% of STS sales (2025), STS = 50% of group -> ~7.5% from STS; APAC total 18.3% of group revenue. China large-project weakness cut STS organic to +1% in 2025 (3% ex China/Korea projects); China STS sales expected flat in 2026.
